elements.title: Compare Genre Packs and Signature Packages

list.mainText: Genre Packs are new at DIRECTV. They offer the flexibility of selecting multiple packs geared to your specific interests.
Signature Packages offer a wide variety of general interest channels and lots of content for one low price.

faq.title:
Frequently asked questions
Got questions? You’re not the only one! See our answers to the most common questions.

label.title: Can I switch between Genre Packs and Signature Packages whenever I want??
label.content: You can switch between Signature Packages and Genre Packs at any time. Just choose a new Signature Package or Genre Pack and any add-ons when you switch.Once you switch from a Signature Package to Genre Packs or vice-versa, your old selections are canceled. In addition, some switches won’t take effect until the end of your current billing cycle.

label.title: Will I lose my add-ons if I switch between Genre Packs and Signature Packages?
label.content: Yes, you will lose your add-ons when switching to a Genre Pack. The same is true if you switch from a Signature Package to a Genre Pack.However, most add-ons that you can get with Genre Packs are also available with Signature Packages. Just sign up for new add-ons once you get your new Genre Pack(s) or Signature Package.

label.title: Can I use my DIRECTV set-top box or dongle with Signature Packages or Genre Packs?
label.content: Yes! DIRECTV devices work great whether you have a Signature Package or Genre Packs.

label.title: How do I activate and watch streaming services?
label.content:
After you sign up, you’ll be sent an email with all the info you need to activate and watch your new streaming service.

After you activate your streaming service, you can watch on your TV, computer, or mobile device.

label.title: What will happen to my promos and discounts if I switch between Genre Packs and Signature Packages?
label.content: If you switch from a Signature Package to a Genre Pack or vice versa, you’ll lose any promos or discounts you had with your former selections.
